record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.context_brief: Convexity and properness of AdS volume functions
record.original_question: Fix a closed surface S and a hyperbolic metric h_l on S. For each h_r in Teichmüller space T, let M(h_l,h_r) be the unique globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter manifold with left and right hyperbolic metrics h_l and h_r. Are the functions h_r ↦ V(M(h_l,h_r)) and h_r ↦ V(C(M(h_l,h_r))) convex? Are they proper? Does each have a unique minimum at h_l?

evidence.quote: Question 4.3. Are these functions convex? Are they proper? Do they have a unique minimum at hl?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus at least $2$, and let $\mathcal{T}(S)$ denote the Teichmüller space of (isotopy classes of) hyperbolic metrics on $S$. By a theorem of Mess, every pair $(h_\ell, h_r) \in \mathcal{T}(S) \times \mathcal{T}(S)$ determines (up to isometry) a unique globally hyperbolic maximal compact (GHMC) anti–de Sitter $3$-manifold $M(h_\ell, h_r)$ homeomorphic to $S \times \mathbb{R}$, whose left and right hyperbolic holonomies correspond to $h_\ell$ and $h_r$ respectively. Let $C(M(h_\ell, h_r)) \subset M(h_\ell, h_r)$ denote its convex core, and let $V(\cdot)$ denote Lorentzian volume.

Fix $h_\ell \in \mathcal{T}(S)$ and define the two real-valued functions on $\mathcal{T}(S)$:
$$ \mathcal{V}(h_r) := V\bigl(M(h_\ell, h_r)\bigr), \qquad \mathcal{V}_C(h_r) := V\bigl(C(M(h_\ell, h_r))\bigr). $$

Answer the following:
(a) Are $\mathcal{V}$ and $\mathcal{V}_C$ convex on $\mathcal{T}(S)$ (with respect to the natural affine/linear structures arising from Teichmüller theory, e.g., along earthquake or shear paths)?
(b) Are $\mathcal{V}$ and $\mathcal{V}_C$ proper functions on $\mathcal{T}(S)$?
(c) Does each of $\mathcal{V}$ and $\mathcal{V}_C$ attain a unique minimum, and is that minimum attained at $h_r = h_\ell$ (the Fuchsian locus)?
artifact.category_tag: Anti-de Sitter geometry and Teichmüller theory
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work establishes that the total volume V(M(h_l,h_r)) of a GHMC anti–de Sitter 3-manifold is minimized exactly on the Fuchsian locus (h_r = h_l), with the sharp lower bound π²|χ(S)|; this gives the unique-minimum statement for V. The convexity and properness of V and V_C as functions on Teichmüller space, as well as the corresponding minimization for the convex-core volume V_C, do not appear to be settled in the literature, so the question is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Minimizing the volume of globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter 3-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Vol(M) ≥ π²|χ(Σ)|, with equality if and only if M is Fuchsian.
status_evidence.claim: The unique-minimum part of the question for the total volume V(M) is established: V is minimized exactly when h_r = h_l (Fuchsian locus).

status_evidence.title: Length functions in Teichmüller and anti-de Sitter geometry
status_evidence.snippet: new purely anti-de Sitter proofs of (strict) convexity of length functions along shear paths
status_evidence.claim: Related convexity results in AdS/Teichmüller geometry have been obtained for length functions, but not directly for the volume functions in question.
